description: Pick the point (or draw the shape) on the map and the location details are captured automatically.
expression:
Settlement.geo_location → Geo Shape Capture()
  latitude → latitude    [Latitude (centre point)]
  longitude → longitude    [Longitude (centre point)]
  address → q19_1_location_details_settlement    [Address of the centre point]
  ward → q3_ward_no_city_corporation    [Ward]
function_description: Runs when something is drawn, edited or deleted on a Geolocation map (line, polygon, rectangle or circle). Works out the shape's centre point, boundary polygon, area (sq m) and perimeter (m), and looks up the address, pincode, state, district, city and ward of its centre.
name: Settlement map capture
